# AGROBOT-SMART AGRO MONITORING SYSTEM FOR ORGANIC FARMING

# Problem Statement

In modern agriculture, continuous monitoring of individual plants is important for maintaining healthy growth and identifying problems at an early stage. Manual monitoring of multiple plants can be time-consuming and requires continuous human effort.

This project proposes a robotic plant-monitoring system that can move between designated plants, stop at each plant, and monitor its condition using appropriate sensors or a camera. The robot first approaches Plant 1, stops at the designated location, performs the required monitoring, and then continues toward Plant 2\. The same process is repeated for Plant 2 and subsequent plants.

The system is designed to follow a predefined path, with line-cut/line-detection points used to identify plant locations and trigger the robot to stop. After completing the monitoring operation, the robot resumes movement and proceeds to the next plant.

# Main objectives

* Develop an autonomous robot for plant-to-plant monitoring.  
    
* Detect designated line markers accurately.  
    
* Stop the robot at the required plant location.  
    
* Monitor plant conditions using sensors/Camera.  
    
* Resume movement after monitoring is completed.





# 

# Expected outcome

The proposed system should provide a reliable and systematic method for automated plant monitoring, reducing manual effort and allowing plant conditions to be observed at regular intervals.
